scope: Opt-in configuration replay only; no events, sends, call changes, run records, counters or data reset.
identity_policy: Resolve catalog references and existing definitions by exact department-scoped names. UI-generated IDs and graph keys may differ; never force identity counters or reuse observed IDs in another department.

credential.delivery_policy: Username stays empty, so the SMTP executor does not authenticate. A fresh local value satisfies form validation only; it is generated into ignored local settings. No stored credential is extracted or retained.
credential.configuration_origin: Public local replay profile: internal Mailpit host/port and blank authentication. Sender matches retained receiver evidence. Saved credential contents were never read or exported.

replay_order: Verify fictional department and baseline catalogs
Prepare ignored local SMTP form values without sending
Create or verify local SMTP credential through normal UI
Build run card disabled; save graph and verify branches
Apply only listed dispatch settings, preserving all other settings
Assign only Herrmann to the existing Engine 51 Officer / Team Lead seat through Unit Staffing; preserve every other assignment
Enable only the reviewed prepopulate-only run card
Create or verify both workflows with Enabled unchecked; add ordered enabled steps
Reopen all definitions and compare fields; leave both workflows disabled
verification_limits: Configuration replay does not recreate a completed or failed run, a delivered message, or a historical call.
Template/condition preview is not a send and is not execution evidence.
Per-workflow retry settings are retained exactly; this source version worker uses global WorkflowConfig retry count/backoff, so a stored 30-second field does not guarantee observed 30-second gaps.
Source profiles pin application code/support patches; they do not automatically install these UI-authored operational definitions.
The card description is retained verbatim; the actual current package targets Engine and Officer.
excluded_state: Credential contents and identifiers, authentication/password hashes, encryption data and keys
Workflow run/step-run, queues, outbox, audit, disclosure and delivery history
Calls, dispatch selections, unit/personnel status or location history, counters and sequence resets
Automatic workflow activation, provider connection tests, sends or event generation

unit_staffing.all_other_unit_assignments: Leave untouched. The retained baseline and observed replay had the other five seats empty. Never clear other assignments to force that appearance.
unit_staffing.badge_meaning: All configured seats occupied: one of one in this training configuration. This does not establish an operational crew minimum or a required Officer qualification.

nearest_preview.selection_check: Optionally tick Engine 51, move the pin, and inspect selection retention without submitting. The selection is form state, not a dispatch record.
nearest_preview.limits: Recorded values describe the observed fixture, not a newly executed run. Current statuses, positions, scope and provider availability can change results.
